title: UNC's Michael Lombardi resigns as investigation reportedly includes questions about Steve Belichick

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: UNC's Michael Lombardi resigns as investigation reportedly includes questions about Steve Belichick
sources.description: Lombardi had been on paid leave since July. Investigators are reportedly asking questions about accusations of drug use by Belichick, as well as inquiring about inappropriate relationships in the football program.
